regions.merged_text: After finishing your letters for the Ist time last night I started to write both of you and your cousin Sister Mary Eileen Clare. I meant to get them done but it was nearing 11 p.m. and my eyes threatened a strike if I continues. I wrote your dear mother a few months ago when she was quite low. Thank God, I understand she improved some since. . · She seemed to pick up wonderfully two years ago at the happy reunion and Solemn Ist holy Mass. . . But how short the joys of earth! - and the sorrows too! Deo Gr.
